notes.title: An Old Man Must Take His Time: The Bench will now launch in late October!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]We’ve got a little scheduling news: we’re moving the launch of The Bench from late September to late October.[/p][p]Why? You probably guessed it. The surprise launch of Hollow Knight: Silksong has affected a ton of developers who were scheduled to launch on the same day or week, meaning a ton of more games are now being pushed to launch later, in our own previously scheduled launch window, meaning our old man and his pigeons may miss out on your important attention![/p][p]Even benches need their moment to shine, and we want to make sure The Bench gets a fair shot at being noticed, so we’re taking a couple of extra weeks to do things right. The good news is the delay isn’t long at all. We’ll use the extra time to polish, tweak, and make sure every doodle, bounce, and wobble feels just right.[/p][p]Thanks so much for your patience and support, we can’t wait to share The Bench with you in late October![/p][p] – The VOXEL team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: The Bench is heading to Sydney, Australia!
notes.notes:
Hello there old timer,

It's been a while since we've shared an update on here, mostly because we've been very much hard at work to get The Bench ready for launch, but we wanted to share some amazing news with you: 

[b]The Bench has been chosen for SXSW Sydney's Official Game Selection! [/b]

This means our friends in Australia will be able to play the game this October 13th to 19th Here's a snazzy picture to celebrate the selection

PS: We've got another major bit of news, so we'll poke you again soon. The next one is BIG!

notes.title: It’s your last chance to play The Bench Next Fest demo!
notes.notes:
Dear pensioners and pigeon lovers,

The Bench demo closes in a few days, that is on Monday, March 17th! 

This is your last chance to visit our park and play the current build before it’s gone forever, like that one pigeon we threw in the sky and never came back down… 

If you haven't seen our updated Next Fest demo, this weekend is the time to change that, so why not come take a seat and gather, throw, and befriend pigeons while you can! 

And if you’ve already played, why not give it one last go?

This is only the beginning for our old man, however, so join the Discord to become part of our growing community and be the first to find out what’s coming next.

See you on the bench,

 Voxel Studios

notes.title: Our First Major Demo Update is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello pensioners and pigeon lovers!

We hope that you’ve so far enjoyed playing The Bench demo. Since we launched on Monday, we’ve already received almost one hundred completed feedback forms, which means the absolute most to us! 

You’d be pleased to know that as of today, we’re launching a major demo update, which includes many updates directly from your feedback, as well as minor bug fixes, and new languages. 

We want to stress the importance of continued dialogue through your feedback forms, and via our community [url=https://discord.gg/U4XrByqbhc]Discord[/url], your comments, thoughts and feedback helps us shape the game for you, so keep ‘em coming!

If you download The Bench demo today, you will be able to play it in Spanish LATAM, Spanish Spain, Turkish and Brazilian Portuguese, as well as the already available languages: English, Italian, Japanese, French, Ukrainian and Russian. 

[b] Here are all the major updates from this new build:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked the movement system: a lot of you shared similar feedback, so we hope we've hit the nail on the head with the new system
[*] Improved pigeon handling - another big request!
[*] Reworked some parts of the map and bench placements
[*] Revised the throwing system
[*] Made some UI improvements
[*] Added new settings
[*] Improved translations
[*] Revised the party area
[*] Added fast travel between benches via the map
[*] Reworked the brick-pigeon
[*] Fixed the demo end menu
[*] Fixed Ukrainian and Russian language teething issues after thorough LQA
[*] Updated the font to better suit the Cyrillic alphabet
[*] Other general fixes
[/list]

If you’ve already played the demo and left feedback, why not try it again, and see all that’s been added? You’ll probably notice your feedback has made it into the demo already, so check out how you’re actively shaping development!

For newcomers, don’t forget to bring your leftover bread to the park with you, our pigeons absolutely love it.

Best, 

Voxel Studios

notes.title: It's time to play The Bench for the first time!
notes.notes:
Dear Friends, 

We’re pleased to finally welcome you to sit on The Bench with us! The demo is live, and playable for the Steam Next Fest, and the following three weeks after it. 

If this is your first time here, why not watch the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SaF8kgWzgWE&ab_channel=GameTrailers]gameplay explainer[/url] trailer whilst you’re downloading our demo!

You’ll already find today’s build translated in English, Italian, Japanese, French, Ukrainian and Russian, whilst Turkish, Spanish (Latam & European), German, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Brazilian Portuguese, Korean and others will make their way inside the demo during the coming weeks, or will be available at full launch.

We hope you’ll have lots of fun discovering our game world, feeding our friendly pigeons and exploring the park. 

If your favourite language is not available from day one, don’t forget to wishlist the game and keep an eye out on the community forum and on our [url=https://discord.gg/U4XrByqbhc]Discord[/url]. If your language is not in the list of up and coming languages, then why not request it with a message below?

Thank you so much for reading, have an excellent Next Fest!

Voxel Studios

notes.title: Revealing The Bench: Demo Coming to this February’s Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow park goer, 

Welcome, go on, take a seat on the bench, grab the local newspaper and read what’s coming: 

We’re Voxel, an indie development studio from Italy, and together with our friends and publishers Noovola, we’re proud to present to you our debut game, The Bench! 

The Bench brings you to a colourful world where you take on the role of an old man enjoying his final days in his beloved park. 

Made for all those fans of cosy adventures and hidden treasure games. A normal day at the park can see you doodle, feed the local animals, hunt for items and… control flocks of pesky pigeons to create mayhem!

We’re also developing this game with Twitch integrations in mind, so you can live-stream your runs making each one unique, thanks to the interaction with your viewer.

You’re officially invited to join us for the first playable demo on this February’s Steam Next Fest, and we hope you can wishlist The Bench now to ensure you don't miss out on upcoming news.

You can also visit Voxel socials and follow for the latest development updates, memes and pigeon pics via  [url=https://www.instagram.com/thebench_game]Instagram[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/FCT3ryuC]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/VoxelStudios_IT]Twitter/X [/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@voxelstudios]TikTok[/url].

We can’t wait for you to take a seat on our bench! 

Voxel Studios
